source.oltp.note: A NoSQL wide-column database for high read and write throughput at low latency, used for time series, IoT, financial records and other single-keyed data. It is an operational store but not a relational one, and it is HBase-compatible.

proposed_capabilities.name: Source-side change stream
proposed_capabilities.description: A change feed the database itself exposes, so downstream tools can read row-level changes without a separate CDC product. Scored here as a source feature rather than as ingestion.

presentation.tagline: Wide-column NoSQL database for high-throughput, low-latency data.
